avis.titre: Duo for targeting your dark spots
avis.texte: I have a few sunspots I was looking to get rid of and decided to try the Dermalogica PowerBright Dark Spot System. While my sunspots aren't completely gone, they've definitely faded since using this set regularly. Plus, I've noticed my skin tone is more even overall. I use 1-2 pumps of the powerbright dark spot serum on my face, neck and chest in the morning. For the dark spot peel, I use it 3-5 times a week in the evening and leave it on for up to 15 minutes before rinsing it off. (I use it less + leave it on for less time if my skin is feeling more sensitive.) I was gifted by Dermalogica.

This is awesome i saw imrovements on my skin instantly. I use the mask 3 days a week and have noticed my acne scars are fading. I also use the serum every morning and my skin looks so glowy. Gifted by
